questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to experience another Nordic country after having tried USA, New Zealand and latest Singapore. And I had some friends in Finland, which also helped my decision. Finland has some of the best educational system in the world, which I also wanted to try.
